what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Türkiye in Austria: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2132 Turkish asylum seekers in Austria, 1.8% of all asylum seekers from Türkiye.
Refugees from Türkiye, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey with the PKK in periods from 2001 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2017 and over the government in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 3464 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2014.
The figure was at its highest, 4516, at the end of 2023; the main years of displacement in the data are 2006 to 2008 and 2022 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Austria.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Austria only.
